newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Allied Banking mandates US$50 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Allied Banking mandates US$50 mln FRCD.

text.p: Allied Banking Corp has mandated Standard Chartered Investment Banking to arrange a US$50 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue, bankers said.
They said the facility has a final maturity of three years and pays a coupon of 85 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
The management fee for top-tier managers is 21 basis points for an all-in return of 92 basis points.
The sole arranger Standard Chartered Bank, which will fully underwrite the issue.
A co-arranger group is being formed.
